about.title: Engineering Systems in Czechia
about.text: InstaRum s.r.o. specialises in professional installation and maintenance of engineering systems in the Czech Republic. We are officially registered and hold all required licences and qualifications for plumbing, heating and technical works. We speak Czech, Russian and Ukrainian.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We work in Prague and Středočeský Region. We can also travel to other parts of the Czech Republic on request.

items.question: Do you offer emergency call-out?
items.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency call-out and urgent repairs for all engineering systems.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: We work in Czech, Russian and Ukrainian.

items.question: Are you fully licensed?
items.answer: Yes, the company is officially registered (IČO 22348760) and holds all required licences and permits for plumbing, heating and technical works in the Czech Republic.

items.question: Do you offer a free consultation?
items.answer: Yes, we are happy to advise you on any question free of charge. Contact us by phone or via the contact form.
